name: user-lookup-index
prompt: CountUser-style per-user scans walk the whole map on every call (the existing per-user queries in this file are O(n) per lookup). Introduce a secondary index: add a map[string]int (or map[string][]string, your choice, document it) on Store that stays in sync with the primary sessions map across Create, Get expiry drops, and Delete. Add func (s *Store) CountUser(user string) int that answers per-user counts from the index in O(1). The existing behavior of Create/Get/Delete must not change. Concurrency safety must hold: the index updates under the same lock scope as the mutations.
